Name: Visual Outfit
Author: MiniJessia
Description:
[size=4]This is a lightweight alternative to the amazing [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969][size=4]Fashion Sense[/size][/url][size=4].[/size]

[size=3]It was made for farmers that use clothes and hats that provide stats but still want to look cute with other styles. Instead of having to download packs, the mod seeks to introduce the gameplay mechanic of actually having to acquire the clothing items in game in order to use them as visual outfits.[/size]

[size=4]This is how it works:[/size]
- You get 2 equipment window: One is the [i]vanilla equipment window[/i] and the other is the [i]Visual window[/i].
- If you equip any item on the visual window, it will visually overwrite the corresponding hat/shirt/pants/shoes in your character but not use any stats that item may offer.
- You still need the in game item in order to equip to the visual window. You can also unequip it anytime.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] inspired me to make this mod. I'm not talented as a coder but really wanted to add a different way to play with aesthetics.

[i][b][size=4]Disclaimer:[/size][/b][/i]
I'm not a coder nor talented at it and I know how much better a mod made by a real coder is. I just wanted to put the idea out using the means I have. [b]If any real coder wants to take on the idea, please, let me know and [/b][u][b]I will take the mod down so their work is the one used by the community instead.
[/b][/u]
[i][b]Imcompatibility:[/b][/i]
- Wear more Rings (For now, I might work on a compat in the mid-run).
- Any mods that may affect inventory UI.

Let me know if there's any others!

Here's the [url=https://github.com/MiniJess/Visual-Outfits]full code[/url], let me know if there's any way I can improve it.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Visual Outfits
Manifest.Description: Switch between saved outfit looks without changing equipment stats.
